test_title: SSC GD Constable 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and M are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the left of E. Only four people sit between E and G. Only three people sit to the right of F. L sits to the immediate left of M. K is not an immediate neighbour of F. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution: **Given**: Seven people, E, F, G, H, K, L and M are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the left of E. Only four people sit between E and G.
